blocks.text: Online research is liye aham hai ke is se log bohat si maloomat jaldi aur aasani se hasil kar lete hain. Aaj ki duniya mein taqreeban har cheez internet se judi hai, is liye online maloomat dhoondna aur istemal karna aana ek qeemti maharat (skill) hai. Is se students apna homework mukammal karte hain, professionals (pesha war log) apne shobe (field) ki nayi baaton se waqif rehte hain, aur har shakhs soch samajh kar (informed) faisle kar pata hai. Lekin internet ki har maloomat sahi nahi hoti. Kuch websites ghalat ya gumrah karne wali (misleading) baatein deti hain. Is liye yeh aana zaroori hai ke reliable sources se maloomat kaise dhoondein, ta ke jo facts aap jama karein woh durust aur kaam ke hon.

blocks.prompt: Online sources ke reliable hone ki jaanch kyun zaroori hai? (Short question 2)
blocks.explanation: Kyunke internet ki har maloomat sahi nahi hoti; kuch websites ghalat ya misleading baatein deti hain. Agar hum bina jaanche aisi maloomat istemal karein to hamare facts ghalat honge, homework ya research ke nateeje ghalat niklenge aur faisle bhi ghalat ho sakte hain. Reliable source se li gayi maloomat durust aur kaam ki hoti hai.

items: Online research se bohat si maloomat jaldi aur aasani se milti hai.
Students, professionals aur har shakhs is se faida uthata hai.
Har online maloomat sahi nahi; reliable sources dhoondna zaroori hai.
